#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Run fastfetch with a pokeget sprite as the logo, vertically and
# horizontally centered against the system info column.
set -euo pipefail

# --- Mode switch ----------------------------------------------------------
# true  -> always draw a random entry from FAVORITES below (args to this
#          script are ignored)
# false -> forward "$@" straight through to pokeget as-is
USE_FAVORITES=false
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# --- Favourites -------------------------------------------------------
# Each entry is anything pokeget itself accepts: a name, "random", a
# region, plus any flags (-s, -m, --shiny, --gmax, etc). Only used when
# USE_FAVORITES=true above; one entry is picked at random per run.
FAVORITES=(
)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------

# --- Sizing -----------------------------------------------------------
# Width (terminal columns) of the pokemon column. Every sprite is
# centered and padded out to exactly this width, so the info column
# always starts at the same spot no matter which pokemon is drawn.
# Leave empty to default to the height of the whole fastfetch output
# (in rows) each run, scaled by CHAR_ASPECT_RATIO below; set a fixed
# number here instead if you want a constant width no matter which
# pokemon is drawn - if a sprite is wider than this, it's left as-is
# (uncentered).
POKEMON_WIDTH=

# Terminal character cells are taller than they are wide (commonly
# ~2x), so N rows need roughly N * CHAR_ASPECT_RATIO columns to look
# square. Only used to compute the default width above; tweak this to
# match your terminal font if the result looks too narrow/wide.
CHAR_ASPECT_RATIO=2.5
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------

FASTFETCH_CONFIG="${POKEFETCH_CONFIG:-$HOME/.config/fastfetch/normal.jsonc}"

sprite="$(mktemp)"
padded="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$sprite" "$padded"' EXIT

if $USE_FAVORITES && [[ ${#FAVORITES[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    chosen="${FAVORITES[RANDOM % ${#FAVORITES[@]}]}"
    read -r -a args <<< "$chosen"
else
    args=("random")
fi

pokeget --hide-name "${args[@]}" > "$sprite"

sprite_lines=$(wc -l < "$sprite")
sprite_width=$(sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' "$sprite" | awk '{ print length }' | sort -n | tail -1)
info_lines=$(fastfetch -c "$FASTFETCH_CONFIG" --logo none | wc -l)

default_width=$(awk -v h="$info_lines" -v r="$CHAR_ASPECT_RATIO" 'BEGIN { printf "%d", h * r + 0.5 }')
width="${POKEMON_WIDTH:-$default_width}"

pad_top=$(( (info_lines - sprite_lines) / 2 ))
if (( pad_top < 0 )); then
    pad_top=0
fi

pad_left=$(( (width - sprite_width) / 2 ))
if (( pad_left < 0 )); then
    pad_left=0
fi

# Left-pad every line by the same amount (keeps the sprite's shape
# intact) and right-pad each line individually so every line ends up
# exactly $width visible columns wide, regardless of the shape of that
# particular row.
awk -v padleft="$pad_left" -v width="$width" '
{
    stripped = $0
    gsub(/\033\[[0-9;]*m/, "", stripped)
    rightpad = width - padleft - length(stripped)
    if (rightpad < 0) rightpad = 0
    printf "%s%s%s\n", sprintf("%*s", padleft, ""), $0, sprintf("%*s", rightpad, "")
}
' "$sprite" > "$padded"

fastfetch -c "$FASTFETCH_CONFIG" \
    --logo-type file-raw \
    --logo "$padded" \
    --logo-padding-top "$pad_top"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Run fastfetch with a pokeget sprite as the logo, vertically and
# horizontally centered against the system info column.
set -euo pipefail

# --- Mode switch ----------------------------------------------------------
# true  -> always draw a random entry from FAVORITES below (args to this
#          script are ignored)
# false -> forward "$@" straight through to pokeget as-is
USE_FAVORITES=false
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# --- Favourites -------------------------------------------------------
# Each entry is anything pokeget itself accepts: a name, "random", a
# region, plus any flags (-s, -m, --shiny, --gmax, etc). Only used when
# USE_FAVORITES=true above; one entry is picked at random per run.
FAVORITES=(
)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------

# --- Sizing -----------------------------------------------------------
# Width (terminal columns) of the pokemon column. Every sprite is
# centered and padded out to exactly this width, so the info column
# always starts at the same spot no matter which pokemon is drawn.
# Leave empty to default to the height of the whole fastfetch output
# (in rows) each run, scaled by CHAR_ASPECT_RATIO below; set a fixed
# number here instead if you want a constant width no matter which
# pokemon is drawn - if a sprite is wider than this, it's left as-is
# (uncentered).
POKEMON_WIDTH=

# Terminal character cells are taller than they are wide (commonly
# ~2x), so N rows need roughly N * CHAR_ASPECT_RATIO columns to look
# square. Only used to compute the default width above; tweak this to
# match your terminal font if the result looks too narrow/wide.
CHAR_ASPECT_RATIO=2.5

# Extra columns of blank space between the pokemon column and the info
# text, on top of the centering above.
POKEMON_GAP=2
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------

FASTFETCH_CONFIG="${POKEFETCH_CONFIG:-$HOME/.config/fastfetch/normal.jsonc}"

sprite="$(mktemp)"
padded="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$sprite" "$padded"' EXIT

if $USE_FAVORITES && [[ ${#FAVORITES[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    chosen="${FAVORITES[RANDOM % ${#FAVORITES[@]}]}"
    read -r -a args <<< "$chosen"
else
    args=("random")
fi

pokeget --hide-name "${args[@]}" > "$sprite"

sprite_lines=$(wc -l < "$sprite")
sprite_width=$(sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' "$sprite" | awk '{ print length }' | sort -n | tail -1)
info_lines=$(fastfetch -c "$FASTFETCH_CONFIG" --logo none | wc -l)

default_width=$(awk -v h="$info_lines" -v r="$CHAR_ASPECT_RATIO" 'BEGIN { printf "%d", h * r + 0.5 }')
width="${POKEMON_WIDTH:-$default_width}"

pad_top=$(( (info_lines - sprite_lines) / 2 ))
if (( pad_top < 0 )); then
    pad_top=0
fi

pad_left=$(( (width - sprite_width) / 2 ))
if (( pad_left < 0 )); then
    pad_left=0
fi

# Left-pad every line by the same amount (keeps the sprite's shape
# intact) and right-pad each line individually so every line ends up
# exactly $width visible columns wide, regardless of the shape of that
# particular row.
awk -v padleft="$pad_left" -v width="$width" '
{
    stripped = $0
    gsub(/\033\[[0-9;]*m/, "", stripped)
    rightpad = width - padleft - length(stripped)
    if (rightpad < 0) rightpad = 0
    printf "%s%s%s\n", sprintf("%*s", padleft, ""), $0, sprintf("%*s", rightpad, "")
}
' "$sprite" > "$padded"

fastfetch -c "$FASTFETCH_CONFIG" \
    --logo-type file-raw \
    --logo "$padded" \
    --logo-padding-top "$pad_top"
